baseline_needs_historical_data_for_this_: Needs historical data for this cohort to recommend a confidence profile.
baseline_no_historical_data_for_this_coh: No historical data for this cohort. This exact combination of filters returns no rows, so the Model and Confidence advisors can't recommend settings and a forecast can't be generated. Adjust the filters — often the L2 or tariff selections — to a combination present in your data.
baseline_controls_how_wide_the_optimisti: Controls how wide the optimistic and pessimistic forecast range is before the confidence horizon. Higher values create a wider range.
baseline_controls_how_much_wider_the_for: Controls how much wider the forecast range becomes after the confidence horizon. Higher values show more uncertainty further into the future.
baseline_controls_how_many_forecast_mont: Controls how many forecast months use the initial forecast range before the post-horizon multiplier is applied.
common_missing_months_detected_in_histor: Missing months detected in historical data.
baseline_seasonality_may_be_understated_: Seasonality may be understated for this aggregate.
baseline_holt_winters_requires_at_least_: Holt-Winters requires at least 24 months of data
baseline_go_to_the_home_page_and_upload_: Go to the Home page and upload an IBRO Excel file to begin forecasting.
baseline_configure_the_data_mapping_and_: Configure the data mapping and dimension filters in the panel on the left, then click
baseline_the_forecast_will_appear_here_o: The forecast will appear here once generated. Save it to unlock Step 2.
whatif_applying_incremental_adjustments_: Applying incremental adjustments on top of the baseline IBRO forecast
whatif_scopes_chart_to_matching_events_d: Scopes chart to matching events — does not affect Step 1 settings
whatif_base_reflects_inflow_outflow_from: Base reflects Inflow / Outflow from the prior month — an event in month T first appears in Base in T+1
whatif_select_at_least_one_kpi_above_to_: Select at least one KPI above to view the chart.
whatif_select_the_tariffs_you_want_to_pl: Select the tariffs you want to plan with — tariff targeting and the tariff mix axis use only these.
whatif_no_tariffs_selected_tariff_target: No tariffs selected — tariff targeting and the tariff mix axis stay hidden until you select at least one.
whatif_events_adjust_the_forecast_above_: Events adjust the forecast above in real time
whatif_this_controls_how_long_new_subscr: This controls how long new subscribers from this event are protected from churn before entering the at-risk pool. Default is 24 months.
whatif_editing_event_modify_the_fields_a: Editing event — modify the fields above then click Save Changes.
whatif_no_market_events_yet_use_the_form: No market events yet. Use the form above to add events — they adjust the chart immediately.
whatif_apply_a_price_rise_discount_or_pr: Apply a price rise, discount, or promotion to a cohort slice. Yield Events are applied first; Pricing Events layer on top.
whatif_no_pricing_events_yet_use_the_for: No pricing events yet. Use the form above to apply ARPU deltas — changes layer on top of Yield Events in real time.
whatif_one_combined_promo_a_volume_ambit: One combined promo: a volume ambition, optionally with a mix and/or price change on that volume only.
whatif_reuses_ramp_decay_ibro_mechanics_: Reuses ramp/decay, IBRO mechanics, mix control and ARPU blending
whatif_how_long_this_promo_s_subscribers: How long this promo's subscribers are protected from churn (or, for Retention, re-contracted) before entering the at-risk pool. Default 24 months.
whatif_editing_promotion_modify_the_fiel: Editing promotion — modify the fields above then click Save Changes.
whatif_rebalance_the_product_l2_tariff_m: Rebalance the Product L2 (tariff) mix for a cohort's Inflow or Retention to drive a new Blended ARPU
whatif_use_raw_historical_average_arpu_p: Use raw historical average ARPU per tier.
whatif_scale_tier_arpus_to_match_the_for: Scale tier ARPUs to match the forecast's per-scenario ARPU for the selected month.
whatif_no_yield_events_yet_use_the_form_: No yield events yet. Use the form above to override tariff mix — changes apply to the ARPU waterfall immediately.
whatif_describe_the_event_e_g_new_market: Describe the event (e.g., New marketing campaign, Competitor exit...)
whatif_describe_this_pricing_change_e_g_: Describe this pricing change (e.g., CPI +3.9% Jan 2025, competitor promo response)...
whatif_describe_this_mix_change_e_g_prom: Describe this mix change (e.g., Promo pushing High Value tier)...
bulk_combinations_that_already_have_a_sa: Combinations that already have a saved forecast will be skipped. Combinations with fewer than 4 data points cannot be forecast and will also be skipped.
actuals_no_forecast_found_for_the_select: No forecast found for the selected cohort. Use the filter bar above to select a cohort with a generated forecast, or go to Step 1 to generate one.
actuals_the_loaded_forecast_was_generate: The loaded forecast was generated for a different cohort, so its baseline can't be compared against the actuals shown here. Generate a forecast for this scope in Step 1, or adjust the filter above to a scope that has a forecast.
baseline_excludes_an_exceptional_month_e: Excludes an exceptional month (e.g. a one-time bulk subscriber load-in) from the seasonal fit, so Holt-Winters doesn't learn it as a recurring pattern. Cleans the seasonal fit
baseline_parameters_chosen_independently: Parameters chosen independently per series by MSE grid search on in-sample one-step-ahead fitted values. For Holt-Winters, σ is the relative residual SD used for proportional bands; for other models it is the absolute residual SD.
baseline_the_current_cohort_filters_retu: The current cohort filters return no rows in your data, so there's nothing to forecast and no model can be recommended.
baseline_adjust_the_dimension_filters_of: Adjust the dimension filters — often the L2 or tariff selections — to a combination that exists in your data.
whatif_a_promo_price_for_this_promo_s_vo: A promo price for this promo's volume only, applied via cohort-weighted ARPU blending. Never shifts base ARPU.
actuals_illustration_run_a_real_forecast: Illustration — run a real forecast to compare
compare_check_at_least_one_scenario_belo: Check at least one scenario below to display data.
whatif_add_events_below_to_adjust_the_fo: Add events below to adjust the forecast
whatif_applies_from_start_month_through_: Applies from start month through all subsequent months
whatif_applies_to_start_month_only_then_: Applies to start month only, then reverts
whatif_apply_to_this_cohort_month_only: Apply to this cohort month only
whatif_roll_forward_to_all_subsequent_mo: Roll forward to all subsequent months
